subject: Electronic producer genre range and console-era colors
question: Owner-initiated correction to the proposed single producer reference
decision: The DJ/producer needs several reference lanes because no one artist supplies the full genre range. Quantic’s suitability is uncertain. Include qualities from the KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack, bright dance music, Condard-like retro glitch-hop and selected Game Boy/NES/SNES-era colors. New proposed tracks, patches and library purchases are not automatically accepted by this direction.
